questions.explanation: -frei here means free of the named thing: errors.

questions.explanation: -los indicates absence; arbeitslos means without employment.

questions.instruction: Interpret the derived adjective in context.

title: Regionale Standardformen sicher erkennen
goal_en: Recognise selected German, Austrian and Swiss standard differences in auxiliary choice, case/preposition frames, noun gender and verb forms; choose one consistent production variety.
goal_de: Erkenne ausgewählte regionale Unterschiede bei Hilfsverb und Genus und verwende selbst eine einheitliche Standardvarietät.

questions.prompt: Ich bin auf der Bank gesessen. (südliche Standardvarietät)
options: An inflection/case error, not the cited regional contrast
A recognized regional standard auxiliary variant
questions.explanation: Sein with literal sitting, standing or lying occurs in southern standard varieties; it is not automatically an error.
questions.instruction: Recognize regional standard variation without treating every different form as correct.

questions.prompt: Ich habe auf der Bank gesessen.
options: A recognized regional standard auxiliary variant
An inflection/case error, not the cited regional contrast
questions.explanation: Haben with literal sitting, standing or lying is widely used; regional sein variants do not make it wrong.
questions.instruction: Recognize regional standard variation without treating every different form as correct.

questions.prompt: Das Joghurt steht im Kühlschrank. (österreichisch/schweizerisch)

An inflection/case error, not the cited regional contrast
questions.explanation: Both der Joghurt and das Joghurt are standard; neuter is especially associated with Austria and Switzerland.
